results.title: Crane Notice - 2701 Broadway, Manhattan (tower crane)
results.content: A tower crane has been approved at 2701 Broadway for the construction of a residential building. See the notice for height and dates.

results.raw_content: NYC Department of Buildings - Crane Notice CN-26-0914 (fixture). Location: 2701 Broadway, Manhattan. A tower crane has been approved at 2701 Broadway for the construction of a 16-story residential building. The crane will reach a maximum height of 230 feet above grade. The crane will remain erected from September 14, 2026 through November 30, 2026. Crane operations are permitted Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
